cases.situation: I'm 3 months into a new job and need Dec 15 to 23 off for my cousin's wedding in Hyderabad. The Q4 dashboard ships by the 12th and Owen can cover the Monday data sync. Worried it looks bad being so new. Slack to my manager.
cases.reply: I'd like to take 15 to 23 December off for a family wedding in Hyderabad, back on the 24th. The Q4 reporting dashboard will ship by the 12th, and Owen has agreed to cover the Monday data sync while I'm away. Can you approve so I can book flights this week?
cases.note: Being new is not a reason to over-explain; asking early with coverage sorted is what makes it look good.

cases.situation: Ich bin heute krank (Migräne) und muss meiner Teamleiterin Frau Becker schreiben. Um 10 Uhr hätte ich das Kundenmeeting mit der Schulz GmbH, mein Kollege Jonas kann es übernehmen.
cases.reply: Guten Morgen Frau Becker, ich bin krank und komme heute nicht. Dringend ist nur das Meeting mit der Schulz GmbH um 10 Uhr: Jonas übernimmt es, ich habe ihm die Unterlagen eben geschickt. Ich melde mich morgen früh mit einem Update.
cases.note: Die Diagnose bleibt draußen. 'Krank' reicht, die Übergabe ist der nützliche Teil.

cases.situation: 我请了10月12日到16日的年假，领导回复说那周要上线新系统，问我能不能换个时间。机票还没订。
cases.reply: 明白，上线那周确实需要人手。那我改到10月26日到30日可以吗？上线后的问题我也能先处理完再走。希望这周能定下来，我好订票。
cases.note: 接受领导的顾虑，但马上给出一个具体的新日期并要求本周确定，别让假期无限期往后拖。

cases.situation: I'm pregnant, due March 3, 2027, and planning 16 weeks of leave. I want to tell my manager Chris on Slack before I start showing. I'm leading our Q1 billing migration.
cases.reply: Hi Chris, some news: I'm expecting, due 3 March. I'm planning to take 16 weeks of leave starting around 22 February, which puts my return in mid-June. I know that overlaps with the billing migration, so I'd like to start a handover plan in early January. Could we book 30 minutes next week to talk it through?
cases.note: News and timeline in one message so planning can start; naming the project overlap yourself is what makes the conversation easy. No medical detail needed.

cases.situation: 奶奶昨晚去世了，要回湖南衡阳老家办后事。想跟领导王经理请丧假：明天9月30号，加上国庆节后的10月8、9号，10号周六调休上班那天回来。原定明天要交的渠道方案，同事小刘可以接。
cases.reply: 王经理，我奶奶昨晚去世了，需要回衡阳老家处理后事。想请明天9月30日和节后10月8日、9日的丧假，10月10日周六调休上班那天回来。原定明天交的渠道方案，我今晚把初稿发给小刘，后面的修改由她跟进。我今天在系统里提交申请，麻烦您批一下。
cases.note: 丧假：一句话说清事情，围绕国庆写准日期，交代交接，再在系统里提申请；其他细节不用多说。

cases.situation: Texted my manager Kevin this morning that I'm sick and not coming in. He replied 'What's going on? You seemed fine yesterday.' Priya is covering my 11am client call and the notes are in the shared drive. I don't want to go into it.
cases.reply: Nothing I need help with, just unwell today. Priya has the 11am client call and the notes are in the shared drive. I'll check messages once this afternoon and update you tomorrow morning.
cases.note: Answers the question without a diagnosis or a defence, then restates cover and the next check-in.

cases.situation: 我爸10月19号在老家做髋关节置换手术，家里就我一个孩子，得回去照顾两周。年假只剩5天，剩下的想请事假。领导是周总，我手上负责双十一的活动页，设计稿能在16号前交，开发对接可以交给小林。
cases.reply: 周总，想跟您请10月19日到30日两周的假，11月2日周一回来上班。我父亲19日做手术，家里需要我照顾。年假我还有5天，剩下5天按事假走。双十一活动页的设计稿我16日周五前交完，后面的开发对接由小林跟进，我已经跟她过了一遍。您看可以批吗？可以的话我今天就在系统里提交。
cases.note: 照顾家人的长假：日期、返岗日、假期怎么算、交接都写清楚，家里的事一句带过，不讲病情细节。

cases.situation: Trabajo en una cafetería en Valencia y hoy tengo fiebre, no puedo ir al turno de 7 a 15. Mi compañero Álex puede cubrirme desde las 9. Tengo que avisar a Marta, la encargada, por WhatsApp. Son las 5:40.
cases.reply: Buenos días, Marta. Estoy enfermo y hoy no puedo ir al turno de 7 a 15. Álex me cubre desde las 9, así que falta cubrir la apertura de 7 a 9. Mañana antes de las 12 te digo cómo sigo.
cases.note: Trabajo por turnos: el mensaje sale antes de la apertura, dice qué hueco queda sin cubrir y cuándo vuelves a avisar. La fiebre no hace falta mencionarla.

cases.situation: I was off sick yesterday, Monday, just the one day. My manager Ruth has now messaged asking me to bring a doctor's note. Our handbook says a note is only needed after three consecutive days, and a GP appointment here takes about a week.
cases.reply: Hi Ruth, I'm back and feeling better today. On the note: the handbook says one is needed after three consecutive days off, so I didn't get one for a single day, and GP appointments here are about a week out. If there's a different policy for our team, could you point me to it? If so, I'll ask the surgery for a letter.
cases.note: Point to the written policy instead of arguing, stay willing, and check with HR only if she insists against the handbook.

cases.situation: I have a standing appointment every Thursday at 4pm for six weeks, starting Oct 8, so I'd need to leave at 3:30 those days. I can start at 7:30 on Thursdays to make up the time. I don't want to say what it's for. Slack to my manager, Dana.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, I have a standing appointment on Thursdays at 4pm for six weeks, 8 October to 12 November, so I'd like to leave at 3:30 on those days. I'll log on at 7:30 on Thursdays to make up the time. Okay if I block it in the calendar?
cases.note: Recurring absence: dates, how the time is covered and a closed question. No detail on the appointment; 'a standing appointment' is complete.

cases.situation: I've been off sick since last Thursday and told my manager Grace I'd be back tomorrow. My GP has just signed me off until Friday Oct 9. I don't want to share details, and I was meant to present the regional numbers at Thursday's Q3 review; Tom has my slides and knows the numbers.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, an update: I'm still unwell and my GP has signed me off until Friday 9 October, so I'll be back on Monday the 12th. I'll email the fit note to you and HR today. For Thursday's Q3 review, Tom has my slides and knows the regional numbers well enough to present them. I'll let you know by Thursday the 8th if anything changes.
cases.note: Extending sick leave: new return date first, the note sent without being asked, cover for the one thing that matters, and still no diagnosis or apology.

cases.situation: 下午两点幼儿园老师打电话，说儿子发烧，要家长马上接走。我得两点半走，四点半的供应商周会本来是我主持，可以交给小陈。领导是赵姐，想在企业微信上跟她说一声。
cases.reply: 赵姐，幼儿园刚来电话要我去接孩子，我今天两点半先走。四点半的供应商周会我已经请小陈主持，议程和上周的数据都发给他了。我手机一直开着，有急事随时打给我，明早我再跟您同步进度。
cases.note: 临时早退：几点走、手上的事谁接、怎么找到你，三句话说清；孩子的病情不用细讲。

cases.situation: 我是自由插画师，每周给一个茶饮品牌画3张社交媒体插图，按月结。想10月19日到25日休息一周，要提前跟对接人李经理说一声。
cases.reply: 李经理您好，我10月19日到25日休息一周，26日周一恢复正常供图。那一周的3张图我会在10月16日周五前提前交给您，修改也在那周内改完。如果那周有临时要用的图，麻烦10月14日前告诉我，我一起赶出来。您看这样安排可以吗？
cases.note: 自由职业者不需要“批假”，但对客户要像员工一样说清楚：日期、提前交付、临时需求的截止时间，再加一个封闭的问题。

cases.situation: I want five weeks off in May 2027 to walk the Camino de Santiago with my dad, who's 70. I'll only have three weeks of vacation for it, so two would be unpaid. Our handbook says unpaid leave is at the manager's discretion. The spring pricing review ends in April and Hana can cover supplier queries. Email to my manager, Olu.
cases.reply: Hi Olu, I'd like to take five weeks off from Monday 3 May to Friday 4 June 2027, back on Monday 7 June, to walk the Camino with my dad. That would be three weeks of vacation plus two weeks of unpaid leave, which the handbook leaves to your discretion. I'm raising it early so there's time to plan: the spring pricing review would be done by late April, and Hana has said she's happy to cover supplier queries while I'm away. Could you let me know by the end of October so I can start booking?
cases.note: Tie the unpaid part to the written policy, not to what you assume you're owed, and ask far enough ahead that a yes is easy to plan around.

cases.situation: 我在超市做收银，排班表每周四出。我弟弟11月7日周六结婚，我是伴郎，想提前跟店长张姐说那天别排我。周末人手紧，同事小何说她那天可以顶我。
cases.reply: 张姐，11月7日周六我想请一天假，我弟弟那天结婚。提前跟您说，方便您排班。我问过小何了，她那天可以顶我的班。您看行的话，那天就别排我了。
cases.note: 排班制的工作：尽早说、日期写清楚，把换班的人先找好，老板只需要点头。

cases.situation: I texted my manager Laura at 7am that I have a fever and won't be in. She replied 'Can you still dial in to the 11am vendor call? Just listen in.' My teammate Nikhil already knows the vendor file.
cases.reply: I'd rather not, I'm not up to working today. Nikhil knows the vendor file, and I'll send him my notes for the 11am in the next ten minutes so he can take it. I'll check messages once this afternoon and update you tomorrow morning.
cases.note: Offer the coverage, not yourself: agreeing to 'just listen in' turns sick leave into remote work.

cases.situation: We just shipped a big release after two weeks of late nights and I'm running on empty. I want to take tomorrow, Thursday, as a mental-health day, and my team lead, Sam, has said openly that it's fine to call them that. Nothing of mine is due until Monday, and Aisha can answer questions on the release notes. Slack.
cases.reply: Hi Sam, I'm taking a mental-health day tomorrow, Thursday 1 October, after the release push. Nothing of mine is due before Monday, and Aisha can pick up any questions on the release notes. Back Friday.
cases.note: Where the culture welcomes it, name it plainly; it's still a notification, not a request.

cases.situation: Mes congés du 19 au 23 octobre ont été validés en juillet et j'ai payé un voyage non remboursable en Crète avec mon compagnon. Ma responsable, Hélène, me demande par message si je peux les décaler parce que l'audit Hollis a été déplacé au 20 octobre. Benoît devait déjà me remplacer et connaît le dossier.
cases.reply: Bonjour Hélène, je comprends que le déplacement de l'audit complique cette semaine. Mes congés du 19 au 23 octobre ont été validés en juillet et le voyage est payé et non remboursable, donc je les maintiens. D'ici le vendredi 16 octobre, je passe le dossier Hollis en revue avec Benoît et je lui laisse une note avec les points ouverts. Est-ce que ça te suffit pour préparer l'audit ?
cases.note: Un congé déjà validé ne se renégocie pas à cause d'un nouveau conflit : reconnaître la gêne, garder les dates, renforcer le relais.

cases.situation: I've been summoned for jury service starting Monday Nov 16; the court's letter says it could run to Friday Nov 27. Our handbook says jury service is paid leave with a copy of the summons. I run payroll every Thursday, and Keisha has agreed to cover the 19th and 26th. Email to my manager, Paul.
cases.reply: Hi Paul, I've been summoned for jury service starting Monday 16 November. The court's letter says it could run until Friday 27 November, so I'm planning for two weeks out and will tell you the same day if I'm released early. I've attached the summons and will log it as jury service leave, as the handbook sets out. Keisha has agreed to run payroll on Thursday the 19th and the 26th, and I'll walk her through it the week before. Can you confirm that works?
cases.note: A summons isn't a request: dates, the document, the handbook category and the cover; the only question is confirmation.

cases.situation: 我想下周二10月6日上午请半天假，去另一家公司面试，不想让领导知道。手上的周报周一就能交，上午10点的例会可以请同事小杨帮我记一下。想在钉钉上跟领导孙经理说。
cases.reply: 孙经理，我想请10月6日周二上午半天事假，处理一点私事，下午正常上班。周报我周一下班前交，上午10点的例会请小杨帮我记录，回来我再跟进。您看可以批吗？
cases.note: “处理私事”是完整的理由，不需要编一个；不说谎，也不多解释。

cases.situation: 11月10日に予定の手術があり、11月9日（月）から20日（金）まで休みたいです。有給が8日残っていて、残り2日は会社の規定にある病気休暇を使うつもりです。23日は祝日なので24日（火）から出社。担当の月次レポートは佐藤さんが引き継げます。上司の田中課長に、病名は言わずにメールで伝えたいです。
cases.reply:
田中課長
お疲れさまです。11月9日（月）から20日（金）まで、お休みをいただきたくご連絡しました。予定している手術と療養のためで、24日（火）から出社します。有給休暇8日と病気休暇2日で申請する予定です。担当の月次レポートは佐藤さんに引き継ぎ、11月6日（金）までに一緒に手順を確認しておきます。ご承認いただけますでしょうか。
cases.note: 計画的な手術でも伝えるのは日程・休暇の種類・引き継ぎだけで十分です。病名や経過の説明はいりません。

cases.situation: 老婆预产期是10月20日，公司员工手册写的是陪产假15天，我想从孩子出生那天开始休。手上的APP改版项目10月16日前能提测，之后交给同事阿杰跟进。想在企业微信上跟领导何总说。
cases.reply: 何总，跟您报备一下：我爱人预产期是10月20日，我想按员工手册从孩子出生当天开始休15天陪产假，具体日期一出生就告诉您。APP改版我10月16日前提测，之后由阿杰跟进，这周我先跟他过一遍交接。这样安排您看可以吗？
cases.note: 日期不确定的假，先给预产期和天数，说好出生当天通知，让领导能提前排人。

cases.situation: I'm a secondary school maths teacher. Diwali falls on Sunday Nov 8 this year and I'd like Monday Nov 9 off to be with my family in Leicester. I'll leave full cover lessons for my four classes that day. Emailing my head of department, Mr Clarke, now so it's well ahead.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Clarke, I'd like to request Monday 9 November off for Diwali, to be with my family in Leicester. I'll leave full cover lessons for my four classes that day, ready the Friday before. Could you approve it, or let me know if it needs to go anywhere else?
cases.note: A religious holiday is a dates-plus-cover request like any other; check the school's leave policy for how it's recorded.

cases.situation: I lead a team of five at a call centre and I woke up sick, so I won't be in today. Olivia, our most senior agent, has agreed to run the 9am huddle and take escalations. I need to post in our team WhatsApp group before the 8:30 start.
cases.reply: Morning all, I'm unwell and won't be in today. Olivia is running the 9am huddle and taking escalations, so anything that would normally come to me goes to her. I'll check messages once at lunchtime and let you know about tomorrow by 5.
cases.note: Telling your own team: the same three lines, but the cover has to say exactly where their questions go now.

cases.situation: On 18 September I emailed my manager, Karen, asking for Monday 2 to Friday 6 November off for my brother's wedding in Lisbon, back on Monday 9 November. Theo has agreed to cover the weekly supplier report that week. No reply after almost two weeks, and flight prices keep going up.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, following up on my leave request from 18 September: Monday 2 to Friday 6 November, for my brother's wedding in Lisbon, back on Monday 9 November. Theo has agreed to cover the weekly supplier report that week. Flight prices are climbing, so could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October? If it's easier, I can put it in the leave system now for you to approve there.
cases.note: Silence on planned leave gets one follow-up with the dates, the cover and a date you need an answer by; don't treat silence as approval or book before it's confirmed. If there's still no reply, ask HR or the next manager up how to get it signed off.

cases.situation: I've been off sick for five weeks after an operation and I'm due back on Monday 12 October. My GP's fit note says 'phased return: mornings only, 9 to 1, for the first two weeks'. My manager is Rob, Leanne has been covering my accounts, and I'd like her to keep the afternoon client calls for those two weeks; I don't want to share medical details.
cases.reply: Hi Rob, good news: I'm back on Monday 12 October. My fit note recommends a phased return, mornings only, 9 to 1, for the first two weeks, so until Friday 23 October, and I'll email it to you and HR today. I'll pick up everything I can in the mornings. Could you confirm the plan, including Leanne keeping the afternoon client calls for those two weeks?
cases.note: The phased return comes from the fit note, so quote its hours and end date and send it; how it's recorded and paid is a question for the handbook or HR, not a guess.

cases.situation: I start at Larkfield Design on Monday 19 October, and before I got the offer I'd already booked a trip for Monday 7 to Friday 11 December. I won't have built up much leave by then and I'm happy to take some of those days unpaid if needed. I want to email my new manager, Helen, before I start so it isn't a surprise.
cases.reply: Hi Helen, I'm looking forward to starting on Monday 19 October. Before I do, I wanted to flag that I have a trip booked for Monday 7 to Friday 11 December, which I booked before the offer came through. I know I won't have built up much leave by then, so I'm happy to take some of those days unpaid if that's simpler. Could you let me know if that works, and how you'd like me to record it?
cases.note: Leave booked before an offer goes on the table before day one, with the dates and a solution; how it's recorded is a question for the handbook or HR.

cases.situation: Our dog Juno, who's 14, is being put to sleep tomorrow morning, Friday Oct 2, and I want the day off. Our handbook's bereavement leave doesn't cover pets, so I'll use a vacation day. Nothing of mine is due Friday, Marcus has agreed to take any on-call pages, and I'm back Monday for the sprint demo. Slack to my manager, Jen.
cases.reply: Hi Jen, I'd like to take tomorrow, Friday 2 October, as a vacation day. Our dog Juno is being put to sleep in the morning and I want to be with my family. Nothing of mine is due Friday, and Marcus has agreed to take any on-call pages. Can you approve? I'll be back Monday for the sprint demo.
cases.note: Short-notice leave for a pet: use the category that actually applies, one plain line of reason, and the cover.

cases.situation: I'm on holiday in Porto and was due back at work on Monday 5 October, but I've been ill since yesterday and a local doctor told me not to fly until Thursday 8 October; she gave me a written note. I've rebooked a flight landing Thursday evening, so I'd be back on Friday 9 October. My manager is Sophie, and Daniel, who's been covering the client inbox, says he can keep it until I'm back.
cases.reply: Hi Sophie, I've been taken ill on holiday in Porto, and a doctor here has told me not to fly until Thursday 8 October. I've rebooked to land Thursday evening, so I'll be back on Friday 9 October instead of Monday. Daniel has agreed to keep covering the client inbox until then. I have a written note from the doctor and will email it to you and HR today, and I'll record the extra days however the policy says.
cases.note: Ill abroad: the new return date first, the cover, and the note sent unasked; whether the days count as sick leave or holiday is a question for the handbook or HR, not a guess.

cases.situation: 我老家在新疆喀什，回去单程要两天。公司春节放假是2027年2月5日到13日，我想再请2月2日到4日三天年假提前走。听说组里还有两个人也想节前请假，想早点跟领导吴经理说，好去抢票。年度数据报表1月29日前能交，那三天的客户咨询小梁已经答应帮我看。
cases.reply: 吴经理，想提前跟您请个假：2027年2月2日到4日三天年假，连上春节假期，节后按公司安排正常上班。我老家在喀什，单程要两天，所以想早点定下来去抢票。年度数据报表我1月29日前交，那三天的客户咨询小梁已经答应帮我看，我会提前跟她交接。组里节前请假的人如果多，需要错开的话您跟我说。您看可以批吗？
cases.note: 热门假期提前几个月请，日期、交接一次写清；主动提一句可以错开，但不要先把自己的日期让掉。
